_comment: Hand-curated stop cleanup. Each entry maps a RAW stop name exactly as it appears in the source JSON to a CANONICAL stop id. Ids are slugs. The build script fails loudly if an id here does not exist in the data, so typos get caught.
_compound_comment: These raw names look like TWO stops mashed together by whoever typed the data. A bus cannot stop at 'Mirpur 2 Mirpur 10' as a single place. We point them at the dominant component and flag them for a human to check the real bus route.
_suspect_comment: Gulistan appears in 48 buses, the 2nd most common stop. There is no neighbourhood called Gulistan in Dhaka, so this is almost certainly a misspelling of Gulshan. We do NOT auto-merge because Gulshan 1 / Gulshan 2 / Gulshan Link Road already exist as separate entries and we cannot tell which was meant. A human who rides these buses must decide. Until then it stays its own stop.

suspect.gulistan: Almost certainly a misspelling of Gulshan. Appears in 48 buses. Needs a local to confirm which Gulshan it is before merging.

_tolerances_comment: Applied to every raw name before slugging, unless the name is an explicit alias above. This catches stray punctuation, doubled spaces and case differences without needing an entry per typo.
